## Problem / scenario

Describe the use case with synthetic or general examples, not private chats.

## Proposed behavior

Explain what should change and which provider or export path is affected.

## Acceptance criteria

How can this be tested without using anyone's private conversation?

## Compatibility and privacy

Does this change Chrome permissions, network requests, PDF fidelity,
resource limits or the ability to export Temporary Chats?

Do not include private chat text, PDFs, screenshots, signed provider URLs
or authentication details.
